notes.content:

From [b]20. - 24. August [/b][/p][h3]🛠️ What You’ll See at Gamescom[/h3][list][*][p]Hands-on gameplay demo[/p][/*][*][p]Sneak peek at new features since the last playtest[/p][/*][*][p]Updated visuals, systems, and AI behavior[/p][/*][*][p]A few surprises we can’t reveal just yet 😉[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll also be sharing photos, updates, and behind-the-scenes moments from the show floor, so even if you can’t make it to Gamescom, you can still follow along right here on Steam and on our socials.[/p][hr][/hr][p]If you’re at the event, drop by and say hello — we’d love to meet you in person![/p][p][b]– Active Fungus Studios[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🏁 Medieval Frontiers Playtest Has Ended – Thank You, Pioneers!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Well met, settlers of the frontier![/b][/h3]

The [b]Medieval Frontiers[/b] playtest has officially come to a close, and we want to give a huge thank you to everyone who joined us on the frontier. 🏰✨

Your time, feedback, and support have been invaluable in helping us shape the early foundations of the game. Every bug you reported, every suggestion you made, and every story you shared will help us improve Medieval Frontiers for the road ahead.
[h3][b]
💬 What’s Next?[/b][/h3]

We’ll now be reviewing all the feedback, fixing issues, and working on new features for the next phase of development. Keep an eye on this page for [b]future updates, dev blogs, and announcements[/b] about the next time you can jump back into the world.

If you want to join our betatesting team you can do so on our discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/wNsCZnqKhu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36329779/58394087fa50a45a4fa5fc99b14b4ac5191b7a8b.png[/img][/url]
[h3][b]❤️ Thank You![/b][/h3]

This was just the beginning, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Your enthusiasm has been a huge boost to the team, and we’re excited to bring you an even better frontier experience next time.

Until then — sharpen your tools, gather your provisions, and be ready for the call to return.
[h3][b]
– Active Fungus Studios
[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Thank you - you are amazing!
notes.content:
[p][b]Well met, settlers of the frontier![/b][/p][p]We want to take a moment to extend a heartfelt [b]thank you[/b] to each and every one of you. The support you've shown has been incredible — from the thoughtful suggestions and high-quality bug reports, to the funny, creative, and encouraging messages many of you have shared. We're truly grateful to have such a passionate and engaged community.[/p][p]We’re reading all of your feedback carefully, and have already released the first patches addressing some of the bugs you reported and implementing a few of your ideas. The coming weeks will be busy as we continue working through your reports and making improvements. If it takes us a little time to get to your submission, please know that we’ve seen it — and we’re on it.[/p][p]Once again, thank you for being part of the [b]Medieval Frontiers[/b] community. Your involvement is shaping the future of the game, and we couldn’t do this without you.[/p][p]Stay sharp, and keep forging the frontier![/p][p]
– Active Fungus Studios[/p]

notes.title: The wait is over — the Medieval Frontiers playtest is officially live! 🏰✨
notes.content:
You can now dive into the early frontier experience, build your homestead, manage your settlers, and face the wild unknown. Your feedback during this phase will be incredibly important in helping us refine the core gameplay systems and prioritize what comes next.

[previewyoutube=MvPVTvSFX3A;full][/previewyoutube]

This is an early look at the foundation of the game — expect bugs, unbalanced systems, and plenty of things to polish. But that’s where you come in!

[b]🔹 How to Join:[/b]
[list]
[*] Visit the Medieval Frontiers Steam page
[*] Click "Request Access" (if you haven’t already)
[*] Download the playtest build and start playing!
[/list]
[b]🔍 What’s in the Playtest:[/b]
[list]
[*] Explore the early mechanics of settlement building
[*] Harvest resources, craft materials and build a small settlement
[*] Encounter the challenges and hardships of life on the frontier
[*] Find other survivors out in the wilderness
[/list]
[b]📣 We Want Your Feedback![/b]
Join the discussion on our [Steam forums / Discord / community page — [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1207360/discussions/], report bugs, share your thoughts, or just tell us what worked (and what didn’t).

Thank you for being part of this journey from the very beginning. Now grab your tools, rally your settlers, and carve your legacy on the frontier.
[b]– The Medieval Frontiers Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: ⚒ Devlog #3: Raising Walls in Medieval Frontiers – Crafting, Timber by Timber
notes.content:
[h2][b]⚒ Devlog: Raising Walls in [i]Medieval Frontiers[/i] – Crafting, Timber by Timber[/b][/h2][p]Well met, settlers of the frontier![/p][p]Today we bring tidings from the construction yard — a closer look at the heart of craftsmanship in [i]Medieval Frontiers[/i]. When you raise a hall, a homestead, or a complete settlement in these wild lands, know this: [b]it is your own hand that builds it, beam by beam, stone by stone.[/b][/p][h3][b]A Builder’s Journey – No Clicks, Only Craft[/b][/h3][p]In [i]Medieval Frontiers[/i], we do not conjure houses with a single command. Nay — we build them as our forebears did: piece by piece. Each structure is born of your labor and your tools. When you place a wall, what you see is not a finished shape, but [b]the beginning of a process[/b]:[/p][olist][*][p][b]The great wooden beams are first laid[/b], forming the bones of your structure.[/p][/*][*][p]Next, [b]connecting timbers are hammered into place[/b], locking the frame together.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wattle and boards fill the gaps[/b], shaping walls and doorways.[/p][/*][*][p]At last, [b]stones are set[/b], sealing the frame into a strong, lasting wall.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfkFmVfqJ8s5l_4BTW6cdStSAnfyQzyq5SVQHpFbH-myJJqVDPY93wMHckxiPpN0mFUX94Kur8zaOqog-Vu4cqspTVTndftuUuJGOjlFguHYAe2cFsJvoRlTP1UReim8cMZgXvmBg?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"][/img][/p][p]All this unfolds before your eyes, from your own hands, with hammer in hand and sweat on brow. As you build, the structure takes shape before you — real, rough, and rising with each blow of your mallet.[/p][h3][b]Gather with Purpose[/b][/h3][p]In many lands beyond the frontier, builders are left to stumble — [b]gathering too much, or too little[/b], unsure what their next wall or roof might demand. But in [i]Medieval Frontiers[/i], such waste is banished.[/p][p]When you mark a construction site, it shall be [b]etched into your memory — and displayed upon thy HUD[/b]. From that moment on, the needs of the structure are made plain: how many logs, how many stones, how much iron. No more guesswork, no more burdening thy back with unneeded weight.[/p][p][b]Every journey to the forest, every haul from the hills is guided with intent[/b]. The builder knows what he seeks, and returns with purpose — not in folly. 'Tis a simple thing, yet it brings order to the chaos of construction.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfLq4iZQ3TDWQDsGrwVrezT6h9kp91OLRkuRAxntlOGXI-FpqeSwIPwBycbUaTaZYNlVFJbWQ2KCOLzzIB2q1TxywISQsVbeYEUkJ1T1JPBwJDTJiXmf4vpAnmgX1r1ImjA0z-oug?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"][/img][/p][h3][b]A Home Is More Than Walls[/b][/h3][p]Once your walls rise and your roof stands strong, [b]you may furnish your dwelling as you see fit[/b]. Tables, chests, workbenches, and hearths — all may be placed freely within your home. Should you move a piece close to a wall, it shall [b]snap into place with purpose[/b], adopting a form that suits its surroundings. For [b]each furnishing bears two faces[/b] — one for open space, and one for the wall — so that your homestead remains not only practical, but pleasing to the eye.[/p][p]Whether you're placing a rugged workbench against a timber beam or setting a freestanding table by the hearth, your home shall reflect your own vision and taste.[/p][h3][b]Of Great Halls and Humble Huts Alike[/b][/h3][p]Whether you build a humble woodshed or a towering longhall, [b]the craft remains ever the same[/b]. No incantation will raise your roof, no spell will lay your stone. [b]Each beam is set by your own hand[/b], each wall forged through honest toil.[/p][p]But even the strongest arms may falter beneath the weight of greater works. And so, should your ambition stretch beyond your strength, [b]you must brave the wilds[/b] — for there, amid ruin and wilderness, [b]you may find others in need[/b].[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeuy0qg0EJIV6Ws80HQL4yvSRvcWYTb6-YgiiBIhsBvgFiTxSp0Zy1U8XYMscd5PZ-rciuxUh5Tafyso7L-Zb-XTtraYw3zsvuwaxbbBLOPwesFqT6Pv3uYV_0b8eMqaQMQ34cyTg?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"][/img][/p][p][b]They are survivors[/b], their villages burned, their homes lost to war or worse. Scattered across the frontier, they cling to life in hidden glades, frozen passes, or the shadow of crumbling towers. [b]Wolves stalk the woods, swamps swallow the careless, and the mountains bite with frost and wind[/b] — yet if you endure these trials, you may earn their trust.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfA1YlgwXyc1f3jFM8W9Wi1w7QOe18OuBEEvNySRIXBGIwXG2YiJwVMSaYbkardoYnmZvvJZ9DaHlGoNNnsX0hksL5z3p-ZNkk3uA6Jpn6eJONl8fj1jv2q3DZyAR97sj6GaJhHWw?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"][/img][/p][p]Shelter them. Feed them. And in return, [b]they may take up hammer and hatchet by your side[/b], helping to raise walls not just for survival, but for a new beginning.[/p][p]In Medieval Frontiers, every great hall begins as a dream — but with hands, hearts, and hardship shared, it may yet rise from the ashes.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfRH_Clbkofz8PqDWhBFAqIvIAySai_eN6RKW1IFzUh6khXb6TGotjAPaxhNvoHbeizThtKWyXHPZs_7afMGF1P7se8-gIb6A8HVUW-UoX6xzSgYVfyk_fZlbjA25UmTZqjlEE9xQ?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Join Us in Building the Frontier[/b][/h3][p]The land is wild and the work is hard, but with courage and craft, your legacy will endure. We invite you, brave builder, to take up hammer and saw, to gather your kin and forge a home in the untamed wilds.[/p][p]May your walls stand strong and your fires burn bright.[/p][p][i][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXft79jBZm2QM8qiAal4_Id1IIWDf5q45XzhJ9aFDvDirnGMukSTSLHwV_lXi_gC9L0JN5G8ewmf3QrrhANufVmEBRRuhe_9axMEmRPDHA_Ob8NOTDvUxHmqCAmwOAGrAC2gnawl?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"][/img][/i][/p][p]If the spirit of the frontier calls to you, mark your place now![b] [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1207360/Medieval_Frontiers/"]Add Medieval Frontiers to your wishlist[/url][/u], that you may be the first to answer when the call to build and conquer is sounded.[/b] Let not this chance slip like mist at dawn—prepare your hammer and ready your heart, for the wild awaits![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Hello Medieval World 👋
notes.content:
[b]Introduction:[/b]
Welcome to the first devlog for the production of our game, the "Medieval Farmer Simulator" with insights into the production process, the switch to Unreal Engine 5, the game design and the detailed building system.

[b]1. Switch to Unreal Engine 5:[/b]
The switch to Unreal Engine 5 was one of the biggest decisions in the development of our game. The impressive graphics quality, improved lighting and realistic material rendering provide a solid foundation for the immersive world of Medieval Peasant Simulator.
However, the transition also brought challenges, as many systems had to be adapted. Fortunately, the powerful engine allowed us to integrate smoothly and opened up new possibilities for creative implementations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36329779/8d063711ee865229956e78351c9a63b8c73a8cbf.gif[/img]

[b]2. Game design and detailed building system:[/b]
The heart of our game is the detailed building system that allows players to customize their medieval farm to their liking. We attach great importance to ensuring that the buildings are not only functional, but also aesthetically pleasing. Through game design, we aim to provide a realistic yet entertaining farming experience.

[b]3. Manage resources:[/b]
A key element in Medieval Farmer Simulator is the efficient management of raw materials. Players must acquire resources such as wood, stone and food to expand their farm. Cutting down trees becomes an important skill to obtain building materials for the construction of buildings. The addition of workbenches as central elements for the processing of raw materials helps to ensure that players are actively involved in the production process. Every step, from logging to the production of building materials, has a direct impact on the progress and development of the farm.

[b]4. Beautiful, aesthetic and fun:[/b]
The beauty of the game world is important to us. Our artists work hard to create an authentic medieval environment that transports players to a bygone era. The aesthetic design of the buildings and environments not only contributes to the atmosphere, but also ensures that playing the game is a visual pleasure. The fun factor is at the heart of our game. By combining challenging resource management, creative building systems and the ability to create a thriving city, we want to ensure that every player has a fun and fulfilling gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36329779/1501155759d60195e312fc91b8f39f3d8c4be1c5.gif[/img]

[b]5. Experience ressources visibly in the world:[/b]
Another important feature is the visibility of ressources in the game world. Every item crafted or found by players is visibly placed in the world. This visual representation creates a direct link between the player's actions and the world, which enhances the feeling of immersion.

Thank you very much for your attention.
Don't forget to wishlist Medieval Farmer Simulator, so you don't miss out on any updates and news!
And join us on Discord, if you want to ask questions and just talk about the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1207360/Medieval_Farmer_Simulator/

[url=https://discord.gg/PYUdmc8akq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36329779/58394087fa50a45a4fa5fc99b14b4ac5191b7a8b.png[/img][/url]

Best,
MFS Team
